Command: Quench Not the Spirit; Despise Not Prophesyings
Summary: Paul's Spirit command: quench not the Spirit, and despise not prophesyings — the counterweight to the testing command, which follows it.
Commandment: Quench not the Spirit. Despise not prophesyings.
Application: Testing (the next verses) must not become suppression: the Spirit's work through prophecy is not to be snuffed out because discernment is required. Both commands stand together.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: to keep the church open to the Spirit's gifts while still testing them.
